column2: Once someone becomes a vampire, they're as good as dead...{wait}{clear}Irwin always used to say that...{wait}{clear}If it ever happened to him, I was to cut him down without hesitating... no mercy for a corpse, he said...{wait}{clear}
...Every vampire is my enemy.{wait}{clear}And I will avenge my master, whatever it takes...{wait}{clear}
Why do you ignore me? What a cold man...{wait}{clear}But... that cold look of yours is simply lovely...{wait}{clear}
Do you truly feel nothing when you look at me?{wait}{clear}...You know, your father is ever so good to me.{wait}{clear}So you may do with me as you please...{wait}{clear}
What's wrong, Clive? You don't look well...{wait}{clear}
Clive... please tell me everything about what's happening to your body...{wait}{clear}
Just a little is enough, please tell me... I can't bear to watch you suffer any longer.{wait}{clear}
Does it have something to do with Ravenruft?{wait}{clear}Please tell me... I can't bear to watch you suffer any longer.{wait}{clear}
...Enough, go away... Get away from me...{wait}{clear}
I can't leave you like this! Clive... won't you tell me properly?{wait}{clear}
......{wait}{clear}I was born... of a woman who was offered up as Ravenruft's sacrifice...{wait}{clear}
My father is Ravenruft, the king of the vampires.{wait}{clear}

They kidnapped my mother, and a hunter rescued her and brought her back to the village... but her body had already turned into a vampire's...{wait}{clear}When the villagers found out, they killed her and threw her away in the graveyard, and I was born from her dead body...{wait}{clear}They nearly killed me too, but a devout old couple in the village saved me.{wait}{clear}

The old couple tried to raise me as an ordinary human, but that... ended when they came back...{wait}{clear}Everyone in my village was killed except me.{wait}{clear}They left me alive on purpose... thinking that someday I'd become a vampire mad with blood...{wait}{clear}Then a hunter who came to the ruined village took me in.{wait}{clear}It was the hunter who had rescued my mother.{wait}{clear}That was... Irwin...{wait}{clear}Under him I learned how to fight vampires and the undead. How to fight cursed demons in the deep dark...{wait}{clear}I can't let the blood win... never... Not until I've killed him...{wait}{clear}
Sooner or later, just like he said, I'll give in to this blood...{wait}{clear}
My blood is his blood... I don't care how much of it I spill...{wait}{clear}
But... I'll kill him and put an end to this, I swear it...{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄, I'm heading for Ravenruft's castle.{wait}{clear}I can't take your jobs for a while.{wait}{clear}
Does it have to be now?{wait}{clear}
Sorry... nothing comes before killing him.{wait}{clear}
I've been chasing him all this time. Nothing else interests me...{wait}{clear}
